summary: The American Resolve Institute urges the FCC to adopt the proposed rule and urges the FCC to adopt it with extensive reforms to the E-Rate program. The 30-year-old E-Rate program was originally designed to bring internet access to rural and poor schools at a time when students’ online activities were limited to the occasional use of a dedicated computer lab or library for typing or research skills. Since then, remote internet access has expanded massively and so has the number of hours per day s The FCC comment argues against limiting the E-Rate program, citing budget cost efficiency and affordability.
